bio: Situated just outside the typical medieval village of Buje, this beautiful hotel complex with typical Istrian architecture provides a peaceful oasis for its guests. The Luciano restaurant (named after its main supplier of fresh vegetables) has a welcoming ambience with fine views of the surrounding countryside from its outdoor terrace. Prepared using carefully chosen, top-quality ingredients, the dishes served here are available via an à la carte or on tasting menus of varying lengths. Contemporary meat and fish options with a regional focus take centre stage, accompanied by an extensive selection of local wines....
